popularityEstimates.description: Estimated popularity scores (0-1) based on TripAdvisor must-see reviews, Google Maps mentions, travel blog rankings, and Met official highlights. These are ESTIMATES, not precise statistics.
popularityEstimates.methodology: Aggregated from: TripAdvisor top reviews, Google Maps popular times/photos, multiple 'top things to do at the Met' blog lists (nyctourism.com, sandinmysuitcase.com, viator.com, Reddit r/AskNYC), Met official Highlights page

items.name: Temple of Dendur
items.notes: Nearly #1 on every must-see list; most photographed; Met Highlights top pick

items.name: Van Gogh (Self-Portrait, Sunflowers, Wheat Field)
items.notes: Van Gogh is The Met's most sought-after painter; Galleries 822/825 always crowded

items.name: Roof Garden
items.notes: Seasonal but extremely popular; Instagram hotspot; free with admission

items.name: Greek & Roman Sculpture Court
items.notes: Architectural space itself is a photo hotspot; skylights + marble

items.name: Egyptian Art (overall)
items.notes: 39 rooms震撼; Temple of Dendur drives traffic

items.name: Degas - The Dance Class / Little Dancer
Arms and Armor
items.notes: Especially popular with male visitors and families; Henry VIII armor

items.name: Washington Crossing the Delaware
items.notes: Iconic American history painting; school groups

items.name: Astor Court (Chinese Garden)
items.notes: Especially popular with Asian visitors; unique spatial experience

items.name: Vermeer - Study of a Young Woman
items.notes: Rarity (~35 works total); Dutch Golden Age light

items.name: Rembrandt - Aristotle with a Bust of Homer
Madame X (Sargent)
items.notes: Most talked-about painting in American Wing

items.notes: Excellent after renovation; lower overall traffic

items.notes: Modern art enthusiasts; 5m+ long drip painting
